summary: Filters and converts JSON from an input DAT using JSONPath-style expressions, outputting either JSON text or table-form results.

key_params.name: output
key_params.note: Output filtered result or expression result

key_params.name: expression
key_params.note: Python expression using JSON DAT helper members

key_params.name: holdlast
key_params.note: Hold last valid result on parse or filter errors

key_params.name: customext
key_params.note: Custom editor extension when Extension is set to Custom Extension

key_params.name: extension
key_params.note: Edit/view file extension exposed to external editors

key_params.name: wordwrap
key_params.note: Common DAT node-display word wrap setting

common_gotchas: Input must be valid JSON before filtering; validate or guard upstream text sources.
Table output changes nested JSON into rows and columns, which may need normalization before DAT to CHOP.
Expression mode can use DAT.source, DAT.results, DAT.result, and DAT.expr, so generated expressions should stay explicit.
key_concepts: Converts DAT input to JSON text or extracts filtered JSON data into DAT output.
Filter and Expression parameters choose which JSON values are evaluated or emitted.
Output and Output Format control whether results are text/table shaped and how values are formatted.
Hold Last keeps the previous output when new input cannot produce a valid result.
